report_topic: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin Implementation
observations_summary: The audit found that 55.03% of sanctioned houses were completed by March 2021. Key issues included non-receipt of ₹1,515.60 crore in central assistance, improper utilization of administrative funds, and fraudulent approval of 3,354 houses to ineligible beneficiaries, leading to a loss of ₹50.28 crore. There were also significant irregularities in geotagging and time-stamping of house construction photos.
